name: InterContinental Marseille - Hotel Dieu
positioning: An 18th-century landmark inaugurated by Napoleon III, in Marseille's historic Panier district above the Vieux Port, with a panoramic terrace facing Notre-Dame de la Garde, a SPA by Clarins and a heated indoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base above the Vieux Port, close to the MuCEM and La Vieille Charite
Guests who want a spa and a heated indoor pool in the city center
Travelers who want the concierge's help planning a boat trip to the Calanques

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
Guests can unwind in the indoor pool and have treatments at the Spa by Clarins.
Les Fenêtres restaurant and the Capian bar both have views of the Vieux Port, with dishes and cocktails that use the freshness of Provence.
At the Capian Bar, guests can have the signature gin-based Etincelle cocktail or enjoy Vieux-Port views from a terrace table.
The MuCEM museum is about 0.89 kilometers from the hotel.
La Vieille Charité is about 0.4 kilometers from the hotel.
Dogs receive a personalized dog kit with a plaid, a bowl and a rug.
A nanny is available for hire.
The hotel is certified with the Green Key eco-label.

highlights.text: The hotel occupies an 18th-century landmark inaugurated by Napoleon III.
The hotel sits in the heart of Marseille's historic Panier district and rises above the Vieux Port.
The hotel has a panoramic terrace with a view of Notre-Dame de la Garde.
The SPA by Clarins is inspired by traditional Provencal fountains and lavoirs, the old communal clothes-washing places.
The concierge can help guests book a tour boat to discover the Calanques.

considerations.text: Guest parking is at basement level, on booking request and subject to availability.
Marseille Provence Airport is about 18 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may bring some city noise.
